title: A night in Can Gio
summary: Leave Ho Chi Minh City for the Bình Khánh ferry, give the creek a half day at Vàm Sát, and sleep in the beach town. The shore beside Hàng Dương is the next morning.

days.title: Ferry, the creek, and Hàng Dương
days.body: The road to the Bình Khánh ferry is about 50 km and about 1 hour 30 minutes to about 2 hours, and the crossing itself is about 10–15 minutes. Vàm Sát is open 8:00–17:00. Eat at Hàng Dương after that gate closes, and sleep in the beach town.

days.title: The shore, then the ferry back
days.body: Walk the silt sand beside Hàng Dương in the morning, then take the same ferry back to Ho Chi Minh City.

stops.name: Vàm Sát
stops.note: The wooden boat to Đầm Dơi is capped at two hours, inside a half day at the gate.

stops.name: 30 April beach

approach.note: About 50 m from Hàng Dương if you are already in the beach town.

stops.note: Walk the silt sand beside the market for a late afternoon after you eat.

additions.name: Can Gio salt pans
additions.note: Walk the pans on a sunny morning from December through May.

seoTitle: A night in Can Gio — ferry, creek, and the beach
seoDescription: Two days from Ho Chi Minh City: the Bình Khánh ferry, a half day at Vàm Sát, and the beach beside Hàng Dương the next morning.
